Should We Be Concerned About This Seasonal Virus?
A surge in human metapneumovirus (HMPV) cases in China has caught attention, but experts assure it’s a routine seasonal pattern. The virus causes mild respiratory symptoms, with proper hygiene being the key to prevention.
